estimand: Party-seat response of candidate-share change to actual local-party-share change; not candidate-person effect
signClarification: Positive sign follows explicit delta estimand and beta=1 interpretation; minus signs in prose display treated as formatting slips
fit: separate National/Labour zero-intercept OLS, beta=sum(deltaP*deltaC)/sum(deltaP**2), equal eligible general-electorate-transition weights, unrestricted beta
eligibility: same geography, both contests held, unique actual party candidature and positive valid candidate/party denominators in both years; missing candidature excluded, no zero imputation
candidateIdentity: election-local occurrences only; person identity neither inferred nor required
maori: descriptive paired diagnostics only; never pooled into primary beta, no separate operational coefficient from seven seats
prediction: raw linear C0+beta*(targetP-sourceP); flag out-of-range predictions, no hidden clipping
forecastSensitivity: same training structural beta with each Stage5 predicted target party share; no transform-specific refitting
decision: retain bespoke beta only if clear stable chronological improvement vs1 survives transform sensitivity; otherwise adequate baseline or unresolved. Report raw empirical estimates regardless.
materialityDiagnostic: Predeclare0.25pp MAE gain as an indicative material gain, require positive gain in both chronological holdouts and across retained transform aggregate diagnostics for retention; no significance claim or fitted threshold
antiLeakage: No random holdouts; chronological training years strictly earlier than holdout; only historical2008-2023 inputs and frozen Stage5 predictions; no person links, later effects,2026inputs
limitations: Realized-party structural prediction is conditional diagnostic, not forecasting
